scope: future Hwao-authorized integration of sealed v8; no storyboard-of-record, shared-tool, candidate, audio, or public-asset mutation

encoded_candidate_finding.interpretation: Downscale preserves dominant headlines and plot silhouettes far better than lower support, caveat, citation, and provenance text. The held candidate therefore becomes less qualified, not safer, at common low-resolution playback.

sealed_v8_finding.ocr_miss_interpretation: The same two badge crops miss at every scale while full visual review reads both badges; this is a stable OCR-layout miss, not downscale loss.
sealed_v8_finding.reason: The sealed v8 hold remains visually structural at 360p; changing pixels would add custody risk without evidence.

required_integration_guard: Treat 360p downscale as a representation-boundary acceptance test, not an optional cosmetic preview.
Put every semantic hold in headline-scale text or a persistent high-contrast RESULT HELD capsule; never rely on footer, citation, provenance, or caveat copy to carry the gate.
Keep RESULT HELD visually readable on all seven scenes at 360p after any authorized render, crop, or compression.
Use the pass-5 clean hard-cut contract so the gate remains visible on both sides of every transition.
Reject any integration where result-bearing headlines, numbers, or plot silhouettes survive downscale but their hold does not.
Use human visual review as the decisive 360p badge check; OCR is auxiliary because its misses are scale-invariant on scenes 1 and 5.
